meta.status: Sources are added per question after a literature and guidance search. Relevance is judged from each source's title and summary; a source can help answer a question or address the gap behind it, but its inclusion is not a claim that it improves JEE scores.

solutions.title: Systematic approach towards establishing a National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens
solutions.citation: Vennis IM, Bleijs DA, Brizee S, van den Berg HHJL, Kampert E, Rutjes SA, van Passel MWJ. Glob Health Action. 2021;14(1):1971866.
solutions.why: Step-by-step method to set up and maintain a national record of where dangerous pathogens are held, which also shows where collections could be consolidated.

solutions.title: Establishment of a National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in the Republic of Uganda
solutions.citation: Brizee S, Kwehangana M, Mwesigwa C, et al. Health Secur. 2019;17(2):169-173.
solutions.why: Country example of building a national pathogen inventory in a low-resource setting, including the survey of facilities.
